remarks: Welcome to this ALL-Brick Cape in West Seneca, offering a wonderful combination of comfort and thoughtful updates.  This 3-bedroom, 1.5 bath home features central air, furnace, hot water tank, windows, fully fenced yard with gate and concrete driveway-all updated in 2021.  The kitchen has been updated with new cabinetry, appliances, and a ceramic tile backsplash.  The bathroom features a ceramic tile shower and flooring.  Throughout the home, you will find new carpeting in the bedrooms and luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring in the kitchen and living areas- installed 2026.  The primary bedroom offers generous closet space, providing excellent storage.  The spacious garage features a new garage door and opener- installed 2026, along with a new roof- installed 2026, providing additional storage space.   The dry, finished basement provides additional versatile living space, perfect for a recreation room, home office, exercise area, or extra storage.
